title: Client Manager -Acquisition
description:

title: Growth Office Manager
description:
**About BDO:**

BDO is an international network of accounting, tax, and advisory firms which perform professional services to clients throughout the country and around the globe. The local knowledge of network member firms combined with the international expertise and strength of our network ensures effective and efficient service delivery to all our clients in every country where BDO is represented. The BDO story is an amazing one. At the end of 2018, our global organization has grown to include 80,000 people working out of 162 countries & territories who’ve generated revenues of US$9 billion. Our past achievements continue to be a strong foundation for us, but the world is changing, and we must focus now on defining our future and becoming the BDO of tomorrow – today. This year’s GLOBAL REVIEW aims to demonstrate and clarify how we’re going about achieving this. BDO India builds on foundations of quality and a business-focused & result-oriented approach to servicing clients. Our Partners are reputed to being subject & industry experts and take pride in a work culture that is both client-centric and knowledge-driven. Our expertise lies in developing innovative, business-oriented solutions delivered consistently to clients across industries and borders. As the Indian regulatory landscape has many complexities, we try to break down and prioritize requirements to propose business-friendly and dynamic solutions to clients. With integrity at the core, we bring together global best practices tailored to address local compliance needs through focused advisory & efficient execution.

**Job description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, relationship-driven professional with 5+ years of experience in relationship management or business development to work closely with the Kolkata Partners Group. The role will focus on supporting business development initiatives, strengthening client relationships, identifying prospective clients, and facilitating new business opportunities in the Kolkata market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Kolkata Partners Group to participate in business development discussions and develop actionable growth plans.
* Document discussions, circulate meeting minutes, track action points, and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely execution.
* Identify prospective clients and key decision-makers where existing Partner relationships are not established.
* Initiate client outreach, build rapport with prospective clients, and arrange introductory meetings with the relevant Partners.
* Develop and nurture relationships with corporate clients, business leaders, and senior decision-makers across Kolkata.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospective clients, meetings, follow-ups, and business development opportunities.
* Research the local business landscape to identify target organisations, potential clients, and new avenues for growth.
* Coordinate with Partners and internal teams to support the execution of business development initiatives.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in relationship management, corporate banking, business development, or client acquisition.
* Strong networking and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage senior corporate stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and follow-up skills.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
* A proactive, self-driven approach with a strong focus on client engagement and business development.

title: Insurance Advisor

Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, formerly Max Life Insurance Company Limited, is a joint venture between Max Financial Services Limited, part of the diversified Max Group, and Axis Bank Limited. * Good written and verbal communication skills

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

title: Area Manager - Endoscopy and Acute care & Monitoring
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Medtronic’s Acute Care & Monitoring (ACM) and Endoscopy businesses partner with healthcare providers to improve patient outcomes across the continuum of care. The combined portfolio includes Respiratory & Monitoring Solutions that support blood oxygen management, respiratory compromise detection, and patient monitoring, as well as Gastrointestinal (GI) technologies that enable the diagnosis, management, and treatment of gastrointestinal conditions through minimally invasive procedures. This role serves as a clinical and commercial resource across both portfolios, supporting hospitals and healthcare systems in adopting technologies that enhance patient care and procedural efficiency.
  
  
This is a remote field-based position covering Kolkata and the North East region of India. The role supports both government and corporate healthcare accounts and requires approximately 70% travel, including regular outstation visits across the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving portfolio growth across the ACM and Endoscopy businesses by engaging clinicians, administrators, and channel partners within the assigned territory. This role focuses on expanding product utilization, developing strategic customer relationships, and supporting clinical adoption through product education and market development activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Achieve or exceed sales targets across the Respiratory & Monitoring Solutions and Gastrointestinal product portfolios within the assigned territory.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders including physicians, nurses, hospital administrators, procurement teams, and distributor partners.
* Identify growth opportunities within government and corporate healthcare accounts and execute territory expansion plans.
* Conduct clinical product education and in-service training to support product adoption and utilization.
* Build account strategies that address customer needs, competitive dynamics, and regional market opportunities.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive business performance, territory coverage, and customer engagement.
* Gather and communicate customer, market, and competitor insights to Marketing, Operations, and Research & Development teams.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasting, account planning, and territory management activities.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in Gastrointestinal, Endoscopy, Critical Care, Respiratory, Monitoring, or Capital medical device portfolios.
* Experience managing distributor-led sales channels and multi-state territories.
* Knowledge of hospital procurement processes, tendering, and government healthcare systems.
* Clinical product training or healthcare professional education experience.

title: Area Manager - Technical Services (Concrete)
description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2024, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.76 billion.

**Job Description**

**Overview**

Lead and manage the Technical Services team responsible for providing technical solutions and product approvals for Sika admixtures across key customers, including ready-mix concrete producers, contractors and precast manufacturers. Drive technical excellence, customer satisfaction and business growth by guiding the team in product development, mix design optimization, troubleshooting and on-site technical support.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
:

* Lead, mentor and develop the Technical Services team to deliver high-quality technical support and customer solutions.
* Drive product approvals with new and existing customers in collaboration with Sales teams to support business growth.
* Understand customer and project requirements and guide the team in developing appropriate product and technical solutions.
* Provide technical direction on concrete mix design, product optimization and performance improvement.
* Oversee laboratory testing related to concrete, aggregates and cement, ensuring accuracy, quality and timely completion.
* Guide the team in troubleshooting customer complaints, identifying root causes and developing effective corrective actions.
* Ensure effective planning and execution of product demonstrations, trials and performance testing at customer sites.
* Partner closely with Sales and Product Development teams to support customer trials, product launches and technical validations.
* Review and analyze technical data, test results and recommendations to ensure sound decision-making and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Build strong technical relationships with key customers, contractors, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for product improvements and customized solutions based on customer feedback and market requirements.
* Develop technical capability within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies and competitor activities and translate relevant insights into technical and business actions.
* Ensure adherence to Sika's technical, quality, safety and compliance standards across laboratory and site activities.

**Qualifications**

* BE / Diploma Civil Engineering.
* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Admixtures.
* Must have good knowledge about concrete mix design.
* Experience in designing concrete mixes for various requirements and do batch corrections.
* Thorough knowledge about various chemical admixtures.
* Also, knowledge about different cements and supplementary cementitious materials, testing methods and standards related to cement and concrete

**Additional Information**

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

* Ability to identify relevant decision-makers and independently initiate business discussions.

* Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.

Candidates with experience in banking alliances, transaction banking, API banking, payment infrastructure or fintech partnerships will be preferred.

Existing professional relationships with banks and payment ecosystem participants, along with a demonstrated record of developing and executing partnerships, will be an advantage.

The selected candidate will be expected to build a qualified partnership pipeline, develop strategic relationships, progress commercial negotiations, facilitate partner onboarding and contribute to business growth through activated partnerships.

Performance will be evaluated based on partnership quality, agreements executed, integrations launched, business opportunities generated and revenue contribution.

In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
How you’ll grow At Deloitte - We’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
  
  
Deloitte supports your progression through a well-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent postgraduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
  
  
Deloitte’s culture
  
  
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centred, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
Corporate citizenship
  
  
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience
* 5+ years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S/4HANA with a focus on Tax integration across SAP FICO/MM/SD, including Direct or Indirect Tax experience
* Experience with tax technology applications such as ONESOURCE/Global Next Integration, Vertex Accelerator and Chainflow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, and Sovos
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations, and reporting
* Experience resolving high-priority L1 tickets and supporting L2/L3 tickets, with deep root-cause analysis for recurring system failures
* Experience with SLA compliance, monitoring performance metrics to ensure target resolution times are consistently met
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, and providing user training and documentation
* Expert in cross-functional integration of modules - SD-FI and MM-FI
* Strong project management and leadership abilities, with the ability to independently drive project cycles and deliverables
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time
* Effective communication and strong presentation and team-building skills; proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation
* Chartered Accountant, MBA, Master of Commerce (M.Com), or comparable/equivalent postgraduate qualification, with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Audit

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S/4HANA) Certified
* Experience with third-party tax engines such as Vertex, ONESOURCE, or Avalara, and knowledge of SAP DRC
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, and Asset Accounting implementation
* Experience with ITSM/incident management tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA, including SLA dashboards and incident/problem management reporting
* Experience integrating VIM, Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, or Open Text with ERP systems

**Our purpose**

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. **Professional development**

Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. **Benefits To Help You Thrive**

title: Capital Formation, East
description:
**About the Company**

Oister Global is India’s premier Private Markets Asset Manager. Born from Lumis Partners’ 20-year legacy in India’s private markets, Oister represents the next evolution of that ecosystem built on deep relationships across GPs, founders, and family offices, with roots spanning sectors, strategies, and asset classes.

**About the Role**

We are expanding our Capital Formation team across the East covering West Bengal, Assam, Odisha and Jharkhand and are looking for a high-ownership individual to anchor partner distribution and direct client relationships in this region.

This role sits at the intersection of partner management and investor engagement. You will own and grow a portfolio of B2B distribution relationships such as wealth management firms, family offices, boutique RIAs, and IFAs while also maintaining direct relationships with select LP investors. This is a high-accountability, front-facing role suited to someone who combines strong institutional product knowledge with the ability to build lasting trust with partners and clients alike.

**Role Responsibilities**

* Identify, onboard, and manage B2B distribution partners including wealth management firms, boutique RIAs, MFDs, family offices, and independent financial advisors across the West region.
* Own the end-to-end partner lifecycle - from activation to ongoing enablement, performance tracking, and relationship deepening.
* Drive AIF subscription volumes through the partner channel by providing investment rationale, product training, due diligence support, and co-investor meetings.
* Build and maintain direct relationships with select HNI/UHNI investors and family offices, managing their investment journey from first conversation to close and beyond.
* Coordinate with the investment and investor relations teams to deliver timely updates, LP communications, and portfolio insights to partners and direct clients.
* Represent Oister Global at investor events, roadshows, and partner platforms across West Bengal, Assam, Odisha, and Jharkhand.
* Track partner pipeline, commitments, and conversion metrics; maintain accurate CRM records.
* Gather and relay feedback from the field - partner concerns, competitive positioning, product gaps - to inform fund structuring.

**Desired Profile**

* 6 - 10 years in institutional sales, AIF/PMS distribution, or PE-VC fundraising.
* Demonstrated experience managing B2B partner or channel relationships in financial services.
* Strong working knowledge of SEBI-regulated AIF structures (Cat I / Cat II / Cat III).
* Existing relationships with wealth management firms, RIAs, or family offices in the West.
* Fluency in communicating fund metrics - XIRR, MOIC, IRR, DPI - to sophisticated investors.
* NISM Series XIX-C certification (AIF) preferred; AMFI an added advantage.

**Good to have exposure**

* Prior experience in a growth-stage VC, secondary fund, or private equity fundraising role.
* Understanding of LP due diligence processes, PPM documentation, and fund governance.
* Regional language fluency (Bengali/Assamese).
* Exposure to co-investment structures, secondary transactions, or structured products.
* Experience presenting at investor roundtables or family office forums.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.

* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**• Location: Kolkata / Delhi-NCR**

**• Employment Type: Full-time**

**• Vertical: Government, Private & Institutional Project Sales**

**• Reporting To: VP - Institutional Sales**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for a strategic and seasoned Brand Approval Head to spearhead our product approvals, brand specifications, and empanelment's across government, private, and institutional construction projects. You will lead and mentor a zone-wise team of Regional, Brand Approval Managers, driving high-level ministry PR, stakeholder engagement, and an evidence-based approval pipeline to convert specifications into verified business outcomes.**

**Key Focus Sectors & Project Coverage**

**• Government & Public Sector (incl. Ministries): PSUs, State PWDs, housing boards,urban development authorities, Zonal Railways, RVNL, Metro Railways, DFCCIL, NHAI,**

**MoRTH, CPWD, defense agencies, and key ministries via high-impact PR and advocacy.**

**• Real Estate & Private Sector: Leading private developers and housing/commercial builders.**

**• Structural Consultants & Architects: Key design bodies and engineering consultants shaping material selection at the Detailed Project Report (DPR) stage.**

**• Leadership & Team Management: Direct, mentor, and expand a zone-wise team of Regional Brand Approval Managers.**

**• Ministry & Government PR: Lead high-level stakeholder relations, advocacy, and networking across government departments and ministries.**

**• Approval Pipeline Ownership: Own the documented approval routes—covering manufacturer registration, brand acceptance, vendor empanelment, and project-specific approvals.**

**• Technical & Consultant Alignment: Oversee technical submissions, plant inspections, and coordination with Quality, Manufacturing, and Technical Services while engaging. structural consultants during DPR formulation.**

**• Business Attribution: Link approvals directly to tender eligibility, contractor enquiries, and sales handover, tracking metrics in volume (MT) and revenue.**

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

**• Education: BE / BTech in Civil, Metallurgical, or Mechanical Engineering (MBA/Postgraduate in Management preferred).**

**• Experience: 12+ years in the steel or building materials industry, with at least 5 years leading government/institutional approvals and technical marketing, backed by a proven leadership track record.**

**• Core Competencies:**

**- Proven expertise in high-level government liaisoning and ministry-level PR.**

**- Experience managing multi-region/zone-wise technical sales or approval teams.**

**- Deep technical understanding of TMT reinforcement, structural steel, BIS standards (e.g.,IS 1786), and testing requirements.**

**- Strong existing networks with structural consultants, specifiers, and institutional decision-makers.**

**What We Offer**

**• A high-impact leadership role shaping national infrastructure and industrial growth.**

**• The opportunity to build and mentor a high-performing pan-India approval team.**

**• Competitive compensation aligned with executive responsibilities.**

**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

and partners at the restaurants

metrics to the partner

commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and

Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads

Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise

transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working

knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing

channels

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

description:

The Regional AM Manager leads customer support for injection moulding machines in the domestic market. * Plan and achieve territorial service revenue and aftermarket sales revenue targets in the domestic market.

* Identify customer requirements and service opportunities that can strengthen long-term aftermarket revenue.

**Technical Improvement & Product Feedback**

* Gather structured information on product performance and recurring machine issues.
* Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions for machine-related concerns, and support deployment of actions across applicable machines.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve recurring issues in existing machines and provide recommendations for modifications or customisation.
* Visit mould vendors as required for validation activities.

**Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Conduct competitor analysis and share relevant insights to support future business and service strategy.
* Manage key international customers for product troubleshooting or support requirements, where assigned.
* Collaborate with service, sales, engineering, manufacturing and other internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare service data, management information reports and required operational records.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry in the ERP system.
* Maintain visibility of customer issues, corrective actions, revenue opportunities and pending follow-ups.

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**
**Revenue & Customer Outcomes**
**Service & Technical Delivery**
**Operational Discipline**

* Service revenue vs. target
* Aftermarket sales revenue vs. target
* Outstanding spare-parts payment collection
* Repeat customer and retention outcomes
* Machine uptime and breakdown resolution
* Installation and site-readiness effectiveness
* Closure of corrective / preventive actions
* Customer issue resolution and escalation closure
* Accuracy and timeliness of ERP / MIS data
* On-time reporting and follow-up closure
* Customer visit and coverage discipline
* Cross-functional action closure

**Key Skill Requirements**
**Skill Dimension**
**What We Are Looking For**
**Technical & Service**

* Strong knowledge of injection moulding machines, installation, troubleshooting and breakdown support
* Understanding of mould trials, processing issues, preventive actions and spare-parts support
* Ability to translate recurring field issues into practical technical improvement actions

**Commercial & Customer**

* Service revenue planning and aftermarket business development
* Customer relationship management, escalation handling and payment follow-up
* Ability to identify service-led sales opportunities and support repeat business

**Analytics & Governance**

* Competitor and product-performance analysis
* Proficiency in MIS reporting, ERP data entry and follow-up tracking
* Structured approach to corrective / preventive action governance

**Leadership & Behavioural**

* Team leadership and cross-functional coordination
* Customer-first mindset with ownership and urgency
* Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills

* Experience in injection moulding machinery, machine installation, troubleshooting, mould trials and aftermarket support is preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, MIS reporting and cross-functional service governance.

Master's Degree

title: SAP TM-Manager
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Advisory – SAP TM Functional Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Look For**
**What we offer you**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.
