title: Customer Manager, Building & Infrastructure
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Customer Manager**
, based in
**Kolkata, India**
, you will be a dynamic and self-motivated commercial professional who combines strategic thinking with disciplined execution to drive profitable growth. In this role, you will lead the
**Building & Infrastructure**
business across
**Eastern India and Bangladesh**
, with responsibility for key market segments including
**Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other strategic growth areas**
.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies, identifying and converting new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and expanding Dow’s route-to-market network. This includes working closely with distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other key industry stakeholders. You will be equally effective in engaging customers at the point of sale, influencing project stakeholders, and presenting market insights, business strategies, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to combine customer insights, channel development expertise, project specification influence, value-based selling, and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate market penetration and drive sustainable business growth. Your ability to translate market trends and customer needs into actionable commercial strategies will be instrumental in strengthening Dow’s market position and delivering long-term business success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth strategies for the Building & Infrastructure business across Eastern India and Bangladesh, with a strong focus on Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated market segments.
* Expand and strengthen the retail route-to-market by developing high-performing networks of distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other channel partners to maximize market reach and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other key decision-makers to influence specifications and secure project opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities while maintaining a robust sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management from inception through closure.
* Drive value-based selling initiatives, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, and joint business plans that contribute to revenue growth, margin expansion, customer retention, and channel excellence.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Service, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to deliver customer value while providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and business updates to senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should possess:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Business, or a related field from a recognized institution. An MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, project sales, channel development, market development, or related commercial roles.
* Proven experience serving customers within the Building & Infrastructure, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, Architectural Solutions, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in developing and growing markets through distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and similar channel partners across geographically diverse regions.
* Experience managing strategic accounts, major projects, and specification-driven opportunities while influencing a broad range of stakeholders involved in purchasing decisions.
* A proven track record of independently developing markets, converting opportunities into sustainable business growth, and presenting business strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Eastern India and Bangladesh.

**Your Skills**

* Market development and growth strategy, with the ability to transform customer, channel, and competitive insights into executable business plans.
* Channel and retail development, including distributor management, dealer expansion, outlet penetration, and demand generation.
* Strategic account and project management, including stakeholder mapping, specification influence, and opportunity conversion.
* Value-based selling, commercial negotiations, and development of differentiated solutions that create customer value.
* Business planning and commercial analytics, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance tracking, and corrective action planning.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively present business strategies, market intelligence, and growth recommendations.

**Additional Notes**

* This position supports market development activities across Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* The business portfolio includes Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated Building & Infrastructure market segments.
* Extensive travel is required to develop customer relationships, strengthen channel networks, support project opportunities, and identify new areas for business growth.
* Relocation support is not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

title: Account Manager (SMB) North America
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Own a high-volume Launch portfolio — renewals, upsells, and day-to-day relationships across a large book of startup and early-stage SMB accounts, prioritising by risk and value rather than treating every account the same way
* Run the renewal pipeline end to end — track renewals well ahead of expiry, forecast accurately, and close on time; a slow renewal is the fastest way to lose a low-touch account
* Negotiate commercial terms with confidence — pricing, discounts, and contract length, knowing when to hold firm and when to flex, especially on multi-year commitments
* Spot and close expansion opportunities — accounts ready to add frameworks (SOC 2 to ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA) or upgrade plans, pitched naturally within renewal conversations
* Get ahead of payment and billing risk — step in early on failed payments or lapsed billing before it turns into churn, one of the biggest causes of loss in this segment
* Work the system, not just the relationship — use CRM workflows, templates, and playbooks to manage volume efficiently, keeping renewal stage, risk flags, and outcomes logged in real time
* Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and the audit team to unblock renewals, resolve billing disputes, and report regularly on portfolio health

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 2–4 years in account management, customer success, renewals, or sales, ideally in SaaS — experience in security, compliance, or GRC software is a plus, not a requirement
* A confident, direct negotiator — comfortable discussing price and terms without getting defensive or over-discounting
* Strong organisational discipline — able to juggle a large number of accounts at different stages without letting things slip, working off dashboards and structured playbooks rather than ad hoc outreach
* A clear, concise communicator, written and verbal — this is fast, high-volume outreach, not long relationship-building calls
* Analytical enough to read account data — usage, payment status, renewal date — and decide what to prioritise each day
* Resilient and proactive — comfortable with pushback, price objections, and the occasional lost account, and flags risk before it shows up in a report
* Curious about compliance and security — or willing to get up to speed quickly on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 to be a credible main point of contact for lean teams without their own compliance staff

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
**Implementation – SFA**
to lead end-to-end implementation of our Sales Force Automation (SFA) solutions for enterprise customers. * Strong understanding of sales operations, field force management, and digital transformation in manufacturing or related industries.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.

**Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)**

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.

As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

**The opportunity**

**is an added advantage**
to join the global EY - Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledge on Financial Planning and Budgeting Processes, Financial Consolidation, Cost Allocation and Controllership, EPM tools

* Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure
* Open to travel (Domestic & International)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks and adapt to a changing environment
* Must be organized, focused, and driven to meet established deliverable deadlines
* Ability to lead client workshops and guide on BPRA vision and strategy
* Agile, Learnability and problem-solving approach
* Consulting experience is a must have
* Confident & professional communication style
* Proficiency in English (oral and written)
* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
* Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
* 10-15 years of work experience in BPRA projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Finance Transformation
* GBS/SSC Setup
* Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience

title: Microsoft - F And O Technical - Senior
description:

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise-scale D365 F&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) & B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C & B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and .NET Core.

* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post-go-live to resolve POS-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Ability to conceptualize and design future-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi-country and multi-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**

* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full-cycle D365 F&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail & eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB-340, MB-900 are preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Regional RFQ Specialist
description:
At Pepperl+Fuchs, we combine a strong commitment to innovation with a deep respect for the traditions that have shaped our success. From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe.

Regional RFQ Specialist
  
  
**Job Description: Regional RFQ Specialist – Explosion Protected Electrical Solutions**
**Role Title:**
Regional RFQ Specialist (Asia Support – India, South East Asia, South Korea, Japan, Australia)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Bangalore or Mumbai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Regional Sales Support
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Sales Director APAC
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, commercially minded, and technically proficient Regional RFQ Specialist to join our team at the Chennai Systems Engineering Centre (SEC). In this role, you will act as the dedicated expert on our Solution Engineering Centre capabilities, supporting regional RFQs and preparing technical/commercial proposals for Asia-based sales teams and customers. You will serve as the crucial technical interface between regional sales organizations, engineering, and production—analyzing complex customer specifications, developing competitive cost estimates, and designing hazardous area/explosion-protected electro-mechanical and LV panel solutions to drive regional business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Regional Proposal & RFQ Management (Asia Region)
* Act as the central 2nd level technical support interface for the Asia-wide sales network and regional sales organizations.
* Prepare accurate, competitive, and timely cost estimates, technical proposals, and formal RFQ submissions for explosion-protected electro-mechanical solutions and LV electrical panels.
* Ensure all quotations and RFQs are completed accurately and submitted within agreed timelines and regional KPI targets.
* Technical Analysis & Solution Design
* Review and technically qualify customer specifications, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, and international standards.
* Select suitable electrical components, switchgear, and enclosure configurations tailored to specific customer/project requirements in explosive gas or dust environments.
* Develop basic general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary solution designs, and detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for junction boxes, motor starter panels, and LV panel solutions.
* Perform technical feasibility studies and calculations to support customer quotations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Interface
* Collaborate closely with Regional Sales, Local Engineering, R&D, Product Management, and Production teams to ensure technical and commercial compliance.
* Support regional sales teams in pricing strategies, price-finding situations, and technical query resolution.
* Directly (or via regional sales teams) interact with Asia-based clients to clarify technical requirements and present engineered proposals.

**Role Requirements & Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or B.Tech in Electrical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales support, electrical panel design, estimation, or costing.
* Prior experience in a 2nd-level technical sales support or pre-sales engineering role for control, instrumentation, or electro-mechanical products is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Hazardous Area Knowledge: Familiarity with explosion-protected equipment (Ex-d, Ex-e, etc.) and global standards (e.g., IECEx, ATEX) for explosive gas or dust atmospheres.
* Electrical & Mechanical Literacy: Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and single-line diagrams (SLDs).
* Product Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (LV) electrical panels, motor starter panels, switchgear, and junction box configurations.
* Software Proficiency:
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD / 2D Electro-CAD tools or ERP systems is a strong advantage.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Communication: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable acting as a regional bridge between engineering and international sales offices.
* Commercial Acumen: Ability to balance technical compliance with cost-effective engineering.
* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Proven ability to manage multiple regional queries simultaneously under tight deadlines.

Are you excited about this opportunity? We can’t wait to get to know you! Submit your application online — we’re looking forward to hearing from you!

We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of ethnicity, country of origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, skin color, physical or mental abilities, social background, or any other protected characteristic. title: Member
description:
**Company Description**
MeHAN is a human-centered advisory firm focused on closing the gap between buying AI tools and actually using them effectively in organizations. Instead of traditional button-click training, MeHAN addresses the real barriers to AI adoption, such as fear, resistance, leadership gaps, and cultural signals. The company uses diagnostic, data-driven insights tailored to each client’s unique context, avoiding generic best practices. Built specifically for India’s mid-market companies with 100 to 2,000 employees, MeHAN follows a structured four-step process from free pulse checks to custom programs that measurably improve AI adoption. Applicants join a team committed to making AI investments meaningful, practical, and measurable for clients.
  
**Role Description**
As a Member at MeHAN, you will work full time on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, contributing to diagnostic-led advisory projects that help clients improve AI adoption. You will support the design and delivery of pulse checks and team-wide diagnostics, gather and interpret organizational data, and help translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client teams. You will collaborate with colleagues to shape custom programs that address behavioral, cultural, and leadership barriers to AI usage, and assist in tracking impact and adoption metrics over time. The role involves direct interaction with client stakeholders, participation in workshops and discussions, and ongoing documentation and reporting to ensure clarity, consistency, and measurable outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand organizational behavior, culture, and change dynamics, and apply these insights to improve technology adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with diagnostic data, surveys, or structured assessments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Comfort working in client-facing environments, with skills in collaboration, facilitation, and building trust across teams.
* Interest in AI, digital transformation, or technology-enabled change, and willingness to learn about emerging tools and practices.
* Ability to work on-site full time in the Greater Kolkata Area, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving advisory setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, psychology, sociology, technology, or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in consulting, HR, L&D, or transformation roles is an advantage.
* Demonstrated integrity, respect for diverse perspectives, and commitment to non-discriminatory, inclusive work practices.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Relationship Manager - Private Wealth
description:
**Job role & Responsibilities:**

* To build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals to understand their financial goals and objectives.
* To provide personalized financial advice and wealth management solutions to clients based on their needs and risk appetite.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Implementation Lead -AI/ML
description:
**About Superteams**

Superteams builds AI-powered products and solutions that help businesses solve real-world problems through intelligent automation.

We work with businesses to build, integrate, and deploy cutting-edge AI applications, helping them turn emerging technologies into practical business solutions.

We are looking for an
**AI/ML Product Implementation Lead**

who can manage a small technical team, drive product implementations, and work closely with our engineering and customer teams to deliver reliable solutions.

This is an opportunity to work in an
**agile startup environment alongside cutting-edge AI/ML technologies**

, contribute to real-world projects, and take ownership of solutions from development to deployment.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and coordinate a team of engineers working on product development and implementation.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable technical tasks.
* Plan implementation activities, allocate work, track progress, and ensure timely delivery.
* Work closely with developers to build, integrate, test, and deploy software solutions.
* Coordinate integrations with APIs, databases, CRMs, and third-party applications.
* Oversee deployments across cloud environments and customer infrastructure.
* Participate in technical discussions, troubleshoot issues, and help the team resolve implementation challenges.
* Work with the Product and Engineering teams to improve product functionality based on customer feedback.
* Communicate project progress, risks, and dependencies to internal stakeholders and customers.
* Maintain implementation documentation and establish effective development and deployment practices.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and help the team explore new tools and approaches.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience & Technical Skills**

* 4+ years of experience in software development, product implementation, technical consulting, or a related engineering role.
* Strong programming fundamentals, preferably with hands-on experience in Python.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, and software integrations.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and application deployment.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applications is an advantage, but extensive specialised experience is not required.
* Experience taking software projects from development or POC to deployment is preferred.

**Team Leadership & Project Management**

* Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of developers or engineers.
* Ability to break down requirements into tasks, assign responsibilities, and track execution.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to identify blockers, solve problems, and keep projects moving.
* Comfortable working directly with customers and communicating technical requirements.
* A proactive approach to ownership, accountability, and team collaboration.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLM-based applications, RAG, AI agents, or other Generative AI solutions.
* Familiarity with vector databases and AI application frameworks.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI deployments or GPU infrastructure.
* Experience with vLLM, SGLang, or private and sovereign AI deployments.
* Experience working in a product company, startup, or client-facing engineering environment.

title: Outbound Lead Development Representative – National
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai

Our equipment keeps workers safe at
**4,142+ customers**
across
**65+ countries**
— when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.

We're on our way to
**10,000 protected workplaces by 2035**

**About the Role**

* Demand generation engine of our national outbound motion, with India as your market
* Research target companies in our focus industries and develop interest into sales-ready opportunities
* Move each contact from Prospect (MQL) to a sales-qualified lead (SQL) that Sales accepts, with a meeting on the calendar
* Full-cycle prospecting seat: you own the bridge into Sales, you do not negotiate or close, and you carry no pricing authority
* Fully digital and desk-based, with no field visits

**Research and Target**

* Identify and research target companies in India against the defined ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Build and maintain target account lists
* Map the decision-makers and buying committee in each account

**Enrich and Maintain Data**

* Source and validate contact information using approved tools
* Keep every prospect record in CRM accurate, complete and up to date

**Pitch and Develop**

* Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp (where applicable)
* Personalise every message and follow the defined sequences and cadences
* Open real conversations with plant, EHS, safety and procurement buyers

**Qualify MQL to SQL**

* Run a structured qualification against the criteria set by management and Sales
* Capture buying signals and make an honest qualify or reject call on every lead
* Understand each account's scope and potential

**Fix the Meeting**

* Secure a genuine meeting or next step with Sales and hand over cleanly
* Move real opportunities forward, not just pricing requests

**Build Qualified Pipeline**

* Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline for Sales, with clear opportunity value

**Keep the CRM Honest**

* Log every contact, activity, disposition and stage in CRM in real time

**Feed the Loop**

* Track outreach and conversion metrics and join the weekly performance review
* Share learnings back to demand generation and Sales so targeting and criteria keep getting sharper

**How Success Is Measured**

* MQL to SQL qualification against the agreed criteria
* SQL acceptance by Sales: a meeting fixed and taken forward, not just a request for pricing
* Pipeline value handed to Sales (for example, INR pipeline developed)
* GP contribution from qualified opportunities that convert into orders

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-4 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, presales, SDR / LDR or outbound business development
* Comfortable owning a daily qualification and calling number
* Hands-on outbound experience (required): reached out to business prospects, run discovery and qualified them
* Strong internet research skills; ideally has researched accounts on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar

**Technical Skills**

* CRM familiarity (required), ideally Zoho CRM, with clean dispositions and stages
* Qualifies with a method (BANT / CHAMP / SPIN or similar), not gut feel
* Can read an account's scope and potential
* Plus: tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Lusha

**Functional Skills**

* Strong communicator with business buyers: clear, confident written and spoken English and Hindi
* Comfortable with plant, EHS, safety and procurement contacts
* Gets the meeting: moves a conversation to a fixed next step, not a soft maybe

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, SaaS or B2B services
* Exposure to technical / industrial products or PPE

**Application**

* Include a link to your 90-second video introduction (questions are in the application form)

**Benefits**

* Own the gate: the call on what is a real opportunity and what is noise is yours
* Learn B2B selling properly: real discovery with real buyers and a real method
* A mission that matters: every account you qualify moves a real plant closer to safe
* Fully remote within India, or office-based at Kolkata HQ (South City Business Park, Anandapur)
* Everything runs on Zoho One

title: Experienced Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Master's Degree in Business Administration preferred

* Change management framework knowledge supporting client transformations
* Designing communication plans for stakeholder engagement and adoption
* Conducting change impact, readiness, and stakeholder assessments
* Developing personas, journey maps, and learning plans

**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.

**Technical architecture & design**

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.

title: AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect
description:
**Location & work modality: India ( Remote)
  
  
**About Submer**
Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.
  
  
We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**
**What Impact You Will Have**
**We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect**
**Department:**
Solutions Engineering / Presales
  
  
**Position Summary**
The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales & Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.
  
  
This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What you will do**

* AI Infrastructure Presales
* Partner with Sales to qualify AI infrastructure opportunities.
* Engage with customers to understand AI workloads, performance expectations, scalability requirements, and operational objectives.
* Conduct technical discovery workshops and architecture discussions.
* Prepare technical proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
* Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.
* AI Infrastructure Solution Architecture

**Design Complete AI Infrastructure Solutions Including**

* GPU compute clusters
* AI Factory infrastructure
* HPC platforms
* High-performance storage
* AI networking fabrics (Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE)
* Kubernetes and container platforms
* AI software stack integration
* Cluster management
* Security architecture
* Monitoring and observability
* Automation platforms
* Scalability and expansion planning

**Develop**

* Solution architecture
* Infrastructure sizing
* Bill of Materials (BoM)
* Reference architectures
* Technical specifications
* Solution documentation
* Deployment architecture
* Infrastructure Integration with Data Center Design

Work closely with Facilities Presales, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure the AI infrastructure solution is fully compatible with the proposed data center environment.

* Rack power density
* Rack layouts
* GPU server deployment
* Network topology
* Cable density
* Space requirements
* Liquid cooling interfaces
* CDU connectivity requirements
* Infrastructure dependencies
* Expansion strategy

Validate that the AI infrastructure can be successfully deployed within the facility constraints without owning the facility design itself.
